author: Engineezy
description:
I've gone full old retired man...
•••
It all started when I printed some Engineezy graffiti onto an old model train car on my E1 UV printer from @eufymake.  It turned out so well that I wanted to display it, but I couldn't have a stationary model train in my shop. So boring.  Next thing I knew, I was at a model train convention after going to 2 model train stores, picking up everything I needed to build a full train layout on my wall.
